products.title: Wheel of Feelings and Emotions Round Rug, Educational Men - Design 100
products.body_html:
This round rug features a colorful Wheel of Feelings and Emotions design, serving as an engaging educational tool. It helps users identify, understand, and express emotions, making it a special addition to various learning environments. Its primary use is to support emotional learning and create a welcoming space for discussion and quiet time.

Product Highlights

  • Features a colorful feelings wheel design to aid in emotional learning.
  • Includes educational animal and shape elements for an inviting look.
  • Soft and durable polyester material ensures comfort and longevity.
  • Designed to maintain vibrant colors for everyday indoor use.
  • Ideal for creating comfortable spaces for reading, learning, and group activities.
  • Easy to clean and maintain with regular vacuuming or machine washing.
